rows.oracle: The root contains exactly five canonical directories and every installed payload byte matches the literal manifest.
Every SKILL.md uses only common-profile frontmatter and no forbidden vendor or execution field.
Every independent directory contains complete literal license/notices and only one-level referenced assets.
Only setup executes a script; preflight detects tampering/mismatch/capability/filesystem failures and asks before every mutation.
The rubric observes project discovery, minimum-sufficient Result handoffs, full proposal/diff, confirmation, valid definition, and no Run.
Invalid critique stops at exact diagnostics; valid critique covers every named dimension and produces no write.
A new Run is created only after the visible exact root/definition/Input/authority/concurrency/provider/isolation approval.
Existing work uses exact Run ID and automation values, reads each binding, prefers ≤3 isolated sessions, and discloses fallback.
Submissions serialize; independent work settles; any non-success triggers re-inspection and stops with no hidden retry.
Separate visible approvals identify the exact refresh target or observed lock ID and cannot authorize each other.
Summary reads only Selected Terminal Results between two matching inspections, distinguishes history, and writes nothing.
No migration skill exists and every non-setup mixed-version preflight routes to setup before project mutation.
Guidance and journey evidence preserve durable model neutrality and settled outcomes without vendor UI/prose dependencies.
